source_blocks.heading: Enhanced Tracking Protection
source_blocks.quote: Just open Firefox and browse with protection already in place.
source_blocks.context: Firefox blocks thousands of known trackers before they can follow you around the web. No setup required. Just open Firefox and browse with protection already in place. You can also see what’s being blocked by clicking the shield icon in your address bar.

source_blocks.heading: Total cookie protection
source_blocks.quote: Cookies are one of the web’s favorite tracking tools, following you from site to site and quietly building a profile of your activity.
source_blocks.context: Cookies are one of the web’s favorite tracking tools, following you from site to site and quietly building a profile of your activity. Total Cookie Protection keeps each site’s cookies separate, so companies can’t connect the dots across your browsing.
